name: Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath
description: Sarnath, about eight kilometres northeast of Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh, is the old deer park where the Buddha is believed to have preached his first sermon to five followers. Visitors walk among the brick foundations of ancient stupas, temples and monasteries, built up over many centuries before the site was abandoned in the 12th century. The lion column raised here by Emperor Ashoka later became India's national emblem.
